contract.word_order: independent shuffled epochs, remainder carried into next batch

intervals: Pointwise Wilson 95% intervals over words for E and A; no seed uncertainty, simultaneous coverage or M intervals

metrics.A: Fraction of words with the state at t correct
metrics.E: Fraction of words with every state through t correct
metrics.M: Mean token accuracy through t: sum of state counts / (words * t)

report.qualification: This post-run assessment accepts only the observed E/A/M length metrics: every prediction and integer accuracy count agrees, and each observed logit perturbation is smaller than half the winning margin. Original strict logit-screen failures remain failures. Probability/loss changes are descriptive; no numerical tolerance was changed. No claim about all inputs, backward gradients or mixed precision.

report.scope: Same-word trained-checkpoint prefix check; subset accuracy is not the full development estimate.

scope: One development seed; fixed 10000-update endpoint, 5000-update diagnostic; no new model inference in this reporter
